args.actions: 1) Baselined status, logs and server.properties at shift start (healthy, 2 players, white-list=false). 2) At ~68s noticed players online dropped to 0 and the log full of "not whitelisted" disconnects; declared the incident. 3) Compared live server.properties to the baseline: white-list true, enforce-whitelist true, max-players 40; whitelist.json empty; 'whitelist list' returned no players. Found the restart at 08:26:02 and the deploy note deploy/2026-11-01-server-properties.md (ticket OPS-250, intended only max-players 20->40) plus deploy/previous/server.properties showing the prior whitelist settings were false. 4) Ran console 'whitelist off' (no restart) — took effect immediately; Paper persisted white-list=false to server.properties at 08:27:16. 5) After Paper's save, rewrote server.properties to also restore enforce-whitelist=false, keeping the intended max-players=40 and all other values unchanged. 6) Verified: Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines reconnected, new players logging in normally, last whitelist rejection at 08:27:14, TPS 20, all 5 plugins enabled, file on disk shows white-list=false / enforce-whitelist=false / max-players=40.
